log.msg: Two real traps in the landing recipe, found the hard way: (1) the ref literally named 'carry-in' resolves to a stale tag (0bf3cb06, some other worktree's launch) that shadows my own branch's actual base commit 1c3b69f4 of the same message — 'git diff --binary carry-in' silently diffed against the wrong, much older point and produced a 57k-line patch full of unrelated files. (2) Almost everything I needed to touch in the main tree (Servex/**, ai2/inbox.js, ai/talk/**, the day page.js) is UNTRACKED by git there — only board.jsonl was in `git ls-files` — so `git apply --3way` had no index entry to merge against and mostly failed outright (confirmed zero effect with a post-apply grep before trusting the exit code).

assign.outcome: Speak a build request; the assistant marks it a task; a Sonnet task mastermind lands a real page; the card's strip goes queued -> working -> landed, live. Proven end to end (5m41s, $2.04) and the max-2 queue verified. Report: /framework/ai/2026-09-22/card-to-task/

**Landed: a spoken build request now becomes a task, and the card shows a mastermind running it.**

The fast assistant decides per sentence — build it (`route: "task"`, a brief in the owner's own words, `state: "queued"`) or just a note/question, no task line at all. [`Servex/agents/Dispatcher.js`](/) watches for a queued task and spawns a Sonnet task mastermind (budget mode, no Opus — two at once, the rest wait), keeping that same line's `state` current as the work moves: `queued` → `working` (with the mastermind's own live one-line progress) → `landed` (with the real link) or `blocked` (with the reason). A child's own wake — done or blocked — is a safety net that posts the same update even if the mastermind forgets to.

Proven end to end on a private Servex: posted the owner's own sentence — "make a page at /framework/ai/2026-09-22/card-to-task/proof/ that says hello and the time" — and 5 minutes 41 seconds and $2.04 later a real, verified page existed, linked from its own parent page and the day. A second sentence, "that looks fine", correctly grew a card with no task at all. Separately verified: three build sentences back to back only ever ran two task masterminds at once, the third queued.

The report, with the strip in every state as pictures: [card-to-task](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/card-to-task/). The built proof page: [proof/](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/card-to-task/proof/). The status strip lives on [/framework/ai/talk/](/framework/ai/talk/) today; on AI 2 only the data exists (`inbox.js`'s fold) — drawing it there is `ai2-master-detail`'s reshape to finish, noted in `doc/logs.md`.
